author: CadillacZach
quote:
Glorification of hood rat behavior even though they have a baby. Mommy robbing stores and Daddy smuggles cocaine and gets drunk and blown out by another dude.
Removed many features previously included in past GTA games. A total departure from the franchise. Refund requested after 2 hours of gameplay, absolutely do not recommend. 
Looks like it was made with AI and slapped lazily over the RDR2 game engine. Nothing new and unique, and many of the CORE GTA things are now gone. I've played every GTA made and this is by far the worst one ever. Not even worth playing. Genuinely angry they ruined this franchise.

author: CadillacZach
quote:
I played the original N64 version when I was a teenager. It's almost unbelievable how faithful to the original this is while also taking the liberty to modernize and expand on certain things.

Overall the same feeling and atmosphere is still there, and anyone who played the original will feel right at home. But there will also be so much new content that even those who know the original like clockwork will be amazed and caught feeling like the stepped into kokori forest for the very first time again. 

The Dev team absolutely cooked! It's very clear that much love, care, and effort went into making this happen for us and I for one am most grateful they decided to do this! I pre ordered this and my expectations have been exceeded, and that's not something easy to do. Especially when I was looking forward to something as much as this I'm going to highly critical of it. 

Literally my biggest complaint is that the new jump button keeps having me roll off the cliff like an idiot because I expect him to jump on his own. 
Literally everything else is perfect.

The only improvement I could think of is giving us the ability to remap any buttons we wanted instead of just a few. The sprint button would make much more sense on the left bumper. 

Other than that 10/10. Absolutely perfect.
